content.title: How To Watch Justin Bieber's Coachella 2026 Performance In Australia
content.text: Happy Bieberchella to all who celebrate Hailey and Justin Bieber Pregnancy Announcement0 seconds of 42 secondsVolume 0% It’s been a long time coming. Justin Bieber‘s Coachella 2026 headline set is one of the biggest and most exciting concerts of his career — for both Bieber himself and his fans. It’s been years since the artist took to the stage for a large-scale concert like this and unsurprisingly, it’s become one of the most anticipated performances the festival has ever seen. There’s a reason people have coined the term “Bieberchella”… While the pop star has performed several times in recent years, including intimate sets at The Roxy and Troubadour in West Hollywood, Coachella marks his first major concert since his Justice World Tour, which he cancelled midway through in 2022 due to health issues. In the years since, Bieber largely retreated from the spotlight — until 2025, when he made a stunning comeback with a two part album release that had fans around the world (including this one), stopping everything to listen. Related: One Fan’s Brutally Honest Review Of Justin Bieber’s Coachella Performance He released Swag in July 2025 — his seventh studio album — followed by the surprise sequel Swag II just two months later. It felt like his most personal albums to date, which is unsurprising, as it’s the first he’s released since parting ways with his long-time manager Scooter Braun. Bieber was officially out on his own, and the result was a two-part album full of honesty and heart. Unsurprisingly, Swag was nominated for Album of the Year at the 2026 Grammy Awards. Justin Bieber performs onstage at the 68th GRAMMY Awards held at the Crypto.com Arena on February 01, 2026 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Christopher Polk/Billboard via Getty Images) As for what to expect from his set at Coachella, sources say Bieber is proud of his Swag albums and wants to spotlight them more than his back catalogue. But don’t you worry, Palm Springs locals who could hear Bieber doing his sound checks throughout the week have reportedly confirmed that he is also packing his set with old hits he hasn’t performed in years, knowing the crowd will want to hear those too. Related: 43 Celebrity Looks That (For Better Or Worse) Defined Coachella Style Leaked soundcheck footage led us all to believe that bangers like “Sorry,” “Where Are Ü Now,” “Baby,” “Favorite Girl” and “One Less Lonely Girl” may all be on the setlist, which proved to be mostly true (more on that below). Reports confirm Bieber will pocket more than $10 million for his two Coachella Saturday sets, making him the highest-paid act in the festival’s nearly three-decade history, and we can only hope the crowd is kind enough to inspire him to launch a world tour for 2027. Never say never… When Does Justin Bieber Perform At Coachella 2026? Justin Bieber will headline the Coachella main stage on Saturday, April 11, with his set starting at 11:25pm PDT. That translates to 4:25pm AEST on Sunday, Australian time. He will repeat the performance the following Saturday, April 18 (Sunday again for Australians), for Weekend 2. As for where to watch his Coachella performance, the entire festival is streaming for free on the official Coachella YouTube channel, and you do not need a paid subscription to tune in. How To Watch Justin Bieber’s Coachella 2026 Set If You Missed The Live Stream If you missed the live stream on Sunday, we have both good and bad news for you. The bad news is that Coachella doesn’t typically upload the full set to catch up on after the live stream has aired, which means tracking down the complete performance will prove difficult, though you may be able to find some songs throughout the week. As for the good news, there’s always weekend two! If you’re wanting to watch Bieber perform live, tuning in for his weekend two set on 19 April (Australian time) is the best opportunity you have for watcing the complete set. What Songs Are On Justin Bieber’s Coachella 2026 Setlist? Any reported setlists for Justin Bieber’s Coachella leaked ahead of his performance on April 11 did prove to be incorrect, but now that weekend one is behind us, we of course have the full, confirmed setlist. It’s common for performers to bring out special guests during their performances, and that proved to be true on weekend one. One special guest we had hoped for though was for “One Less Lonely Girl”, which was on the rumoured set list but did not make it into the final performance. Here’s hoping his wife Hailey Bieber will be brought out to be the one less lonely girl (so sweet!) for weekend two.
